values.value: Finds: SBQQ__ProductOption__c records where SBQQ__MinQuantity__c exceeds SBQQ__MaxQuantity__c. Why it matters: The bundle becomes unconfigurable — CPQ tries to enforce a quantity range that can never be satisfied. The sales rep hits an error mid-configuration and the deal stalls until an admin fixes the bounds. Suppress a finding: essentially never — this is always a data entry mistake. Dismiss only if you've confirmed the bounds will be corrected as part of a planned bulk update. Disable the detector: only if your org doesn't use bundles. Most CPQ orgs should leave this on.
